# Massachusetts Medical Society

> The Massachusetts Medical Society (MMS) is a physician-led organization providing advocacy, continuing education, practice support, and member resources for healthcare professionals in Massachusetts.

MMS serves as the primary professional organization for Massachusetts physicians, offering CME events, policy advocacy, practice management resources, and a member community platform. The organization maintains positions on key healthcare issues and facilitates grassroots physician advocacy.

## Key Topics

- Massachusetts Medical Society
- Physician Advocacy
- CME/Continuing Education
- Grassroots Action

## Advocacy & Policy

- [Key Issues](https://www.massmed.org/Advocacy/Key-Issues/Key-Issues): MMS key advocacy issues: liability, payment reform, universal access
- [MMS Positions on Health Care Issues](https://www.massmed.org/mmspositions): MMS organizational positions and policy statements on healthcare issues
- [Grassroots Action Center](https://www.massmed.org/Advocacy/Grassroots-Action-Center): Grassroots advocacy center for physician member political action

## Events & Continuing Education

- [Upcoming Events](https://www.massmed.org/Continuing-Education-and-Events/MMS-Events-Calendar/MMS-Events-Calendar): MMS Events Calendar for continuing education and CME registration

- [Member Portal Login](https://portal.massmed.org/eweb/DynamicPage.aspx): MMS member portal login for account access and resources
- [Physician Practice Resource Center](https://www.massmed.org/Practice-Support/Practice-Management/Physician-Practice-Resource-Center/Physician-Practice-Resource-Center): MMS practice management resources and support for physicians
- [MMS Connect Community](https://community.massmed.org/home): MMS Connect community platform for member collaboration

## Communications & News

- [Subscribe to Free MMS e-Newsletters](https://www.massmed.org/newsletters): Free MMS e-newsletter subscriptions for physician members
